_meta.name: Kikamba
_meta.translator_note: DRAFT — best-effort machine/non-native translation, not verified by a Kikamba speaker. Do not use in a real deployment until a native Kikamba speaker (ideally from Makueni) has reviewed and corrected every string below. Placeholder is provided so the templating engine and UI layout work identically across all three languages while a proper translation pass happens.

select_language_prompt: Nĩ lugha yĩva wenda? Ĩtĩkĩla 1 Kĩngeleza, 2 Kĩswahili, 3 Kĩkamba.
main_menu:
Nĩwenda kwĩka ata?
1. Kũsisya miradi ya wadi
2. Kũneena ũndũ wa mradi
3. Kũalyũla lugha
no_projects_found: Vaĩ mradi ũonekanĩte wadi ĩsu ĩvinda yĩĩ.
ask_project_choice: Ĩtĩkĩla na nambari ya mradi weendaa kwona.
invalid_choice: Nĩtwĩsũvya, ndũkwataa ũu wasya. Ĩtĩkĩla na nambari kuma orodha-nĩ.
project_statement: {project_name}, wadi ya {ward} ({subward}). Kaunti nĩyatetee {amount} kwondu wa mradi ũũ mwakanĩ wa mbesa {financial_year}, ũthĩnĩ wa {sector}. Ĩvangũ ya kaunti yaĩtye mradi ũũ: {county_status}. Ũndũ andũ ma wadi maneenaa: {verification_status}.
county_status_planned: Nĩwapangĩtwe kwa mwaka wa mbesa ũkasa
verification_status_disputed: Mĩvano - andũ ma wadi mailyũlanĩte na ĩvangũ ya kaunti
ask_report_action:
Ĩĩ, mradi ũũ nĩwaĩthilwa?
1. Ĩĩ, nĩwaĩthilwa - nĩnyĩthĩĩtye
2. Aa, ndwaĩthilwa
3. Nĩwaĩthilwa kĩnini
4. Yeka
Ĩtĩkĩla E ĩvinda yonthe kwona ũndũ wa kwĩka ĩlĩ mradi wĩ mĩvano-nĩ.
ask_photo_or_voice_optional: No ũtũme veni kana ũneeni wa sauti wa ũndũ wonete, kana wĩtĩkĩle SKIP kũendeea ũtena kĩndũ. Veni ndĩendekaa kũtũma ũneeni.
ask_location_optional: Nĩtũvoya woonanie vala wĩ ethiwa nĩwĩtonya, kana wĩtĩkĩle SKIP.
report_received: Nĩtwakwataa. Ũneeni waku wa {project_name} nĩwaandĩkwa na kũĩkwa mbandĩko-nĩ ĩte ĩngĩalyũlwa. Nambari: {ledger_ref}.
report_updated: Nĩtwakwataa - ũneeni waku wa mbee wa mradi ũũ nĩwaalyũlwa.
report_rate_limited: Nĩwaneenete ũndũ wa mradi ũũ ĩvinda ĩsu ya vitũ. No ũalyũle ũneeni waku ũla wĩ vo.
report_flagged_review: Ũneeni waku nĩwakwatwa ĩndĩ nĩwĩkĩtwe kũlilinda kũsisyũwa mbee wa kũvalũkwa kĩyendo kya wadi.
phone_verify_prompt: Ĩkĩla nambari ya namba 6 twakũtũmĩie kũthibitisya namba yaku.
phone_verify_failed: Nambari ĩsu ndyaĩlana. Nĩtũvoya wĩgerie ĩngĩ.
status_changed_disputed_notice: {project_name} nĩyathi mĩvano-nĩ: andũ {threshold} kana kwĩanĩa ma wĩyũmbanu maneenete ũndũ ũtaĩlanaa na ĩvangũ ya kaunti.
sms_help: MŨTŨŨĨSYO WA MIRADI YA WADI. Ĩtĩkĩla na nambari ya mradi na 1 (nĩwaĩthilwa), 2 (ndwaĩthilwa) kana 3 (nĩwaĩthilwa kĩnini). Mbano: KASIKEU-2022-23-001 1
sms_ack: Nĩkwandĩkĩtwe: {project_name} nĩyeekĩtwe {claim}. Nambari {ledger_ref}. Ĩtĩkĩla HELP kwa ũtungĩĩo.
sms_unknown_project: Ndũtũmanyĩkĩte nambari ĩsu ya mradi. Ĩtĩkĩla HELP kwa ũtungĩĩo.
location_permission_prompt: Twenda kũmanya vala wĩ o ĩvinda ũtũma ũneeni, kũtetheesya kũũthibitisya. Ndĩkatũmwa handũ ha andũ onthe vamwe na ĩsyĩtwa yaku.
offline_queued_notice: Vaĩ mtandao ĩvinda yĩĩ - ũneeni waku nĩwĩkĩtwe kĩthengũ-nĩ na ũkatũmwa ĩngĩ mtandao waya.
privacy_notice: Maneeni maku maĩkĩtye ũthĩnĩ wa ĩsyĩtwa ĩtesĩ manyĩkaa, ti ĩsyĩtwa yaku. Ũmanyi wa handũ/kĩlũngu nĩweumagya veni-nĩ na GPS yaku ĩĩkagwa o na ũsao wa wadi. Sisya Sheria ya Kenya ya Ũvitĩo wa Data 2019 na Ofisi ya Kamishina wa Ũvitĩo wa Data (ODPC, odpc.go.ke) kwa mavinya maku ũndũ wa data ĩsu.
escalation_available_notice: Mradi ũũ wĩ mĩvano-nĩ. Ĩtĩkĩla E kwona ũndũ wa kwĩka ĩlĩ.
escalation_situation_no_response: Vaĩ mũndũ waneenete ũndũ wa mradi ũũ
escalation_situation_corruption: Nĩngwĩkĩlaa mĩlomo (mbesa kũalyũlwa, valyũ kũongelwa, mũthũkũmi wa v'ĩ)
escalation_no_report_yet: vaĩ vitũ — tavya nambari ya mradi yĩ vaita ĩvinda wĩanĩanĩsya nao
